patterns.name: Action-near commercial summary
patterns.observation: The quote total, deposit, and payment schedule sit beside the primary send-quote action.
patterns.whyItWorks: The operator sees the commercial consequence and the next action in one bounded region before sending.
patterns.productRelevance: QuotePilot must keep authoritative quote totals and send consequences easy to verify without creating another mutation path.
patterns.proposedUse: Keep authoritative totals and commercial consequences adjacent to the existing send-quote action.

patterns.name: Event context at a glance
patterns.observation: A compact event panel groups date, venue, guest count, and event imagery before quote details.
patterns.whyItWorks: The grouping restores customer and event context before an operator evaluates commercial details.
patterns.productRelevance: QuotePilot quote work is event-specific, but event context must remain subordinate to canonical package and quote state.
patterns.proposedUse: Adapt the event-context grouping through existing QuotePilot tokens and canonical quote-workspace components.

patterns.name: Unverified quote readiness score
patterns.observation: The reference presents a 72 percent readiness score together with an all-pricing-looks-good assertion.
patterns.whyItWorks: A compact score appears to reduce review effort, but only if every contributing rule and source is authoritative and explainable.
patterns.productRelevance: QuotePilot cannot imply that pricing or quote readiness is verified when canonical commercial evidence does not establish that conclusion.
patterns.proposedUse: Display an aggregate readiness percentage and pricing-good assertion.
